Class ResourceValidationHelper

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.resource.ResourceValidationHelper
public final class ResourceValidationHelper extends Object

Resource Validation Helper

Validates domain-specific imported cartographic rasters (biomes, hydrology, geology, and climate) against resolution, aspect ratio, and channel requirements, and manages the visual warning banner.

Since:
1.0.0
Author:

    • applyValidationVisuals

      public static boolean applyValidationVisuals(List<String> errors, boolean showDialog, ResourceBiomeSectionBuilder biomeBuilder, ResourceHydroSectionBuilder hydroBuilder, ResourceClimateSectionBuilder climateBuilder, ResourceGeologySectionBuilder geologyBuilder, boolean isGeologyImportSelected, javafx.scene.image.Image customResourceImage, javafx.scene.control.Button loadResourceBtn, javafx.scene.layout.VBox banner, javafx.scene.control.Label warningLabel)
      Validates resource configuration, highlights invalid controls, and displays the warning banner.
      Parameters:
      errors - list of validation errors
      showDialog - whether to update the warning banner
      biomeBuilder - biome section builder
      hydroBuilder - hydro section builder
      climateBuilder - climate section builder
      geologyBuilder - geology section builder
      isGeologyImportSelected - whether geology import is selected
      customResourceImage - legacy multi-channel geology image
      loadResourceBtn - load button for legacy resource image
      banner - warning banner container
      warningLabel - warning text label
      Returns:
      true if valid (no errors), false otherwise
